newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE ends slightly down, depressed by Dow.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE ends slightly down, depressed by Dow.

text.p: London's FTSE 100 share index finished slightly lower on Monday, depressed by a weaker Wall Street after a day spent dithering in an 18-point trading range.
The FTSE closed 6.8 points lower at 4,212.0 after drifting down as the Dow gave up early gains to be 35 points weaker as London closed. Volume on SEAQ was a mere 580 million.
Dealers said the market had shown little desire to make a decisive move in either direction, with many investors staying on the sidelines ahead of Tuesday's U.S. employment costs data.
"The market just never got going today," one trader said. "A lot of people were waiting for the U.S. figures tomorrow."
